# Coworking Space Al Reem Island — Aegis Coworking (full)

## What is the coworking space on Al Reem Island?

Aegis is a coworking space in Al Reem Island on Level 38 of Addax Tower — a coworking office that founders, freelancers and small teams share, inside the Abu Dhabi Global Market. Members join by the day or month, with WiFi, coffee and meeting room credits included.

## Spaces

- Hot desk (AED 1,000 / month): Any open seat on the shared floor — the flexi desk in ADGM freelancers love.
- Dedicated desk (AED 1,150 / month): Your own desk, 24/7 access, a locker and an ADGM licence address.
- Private office (From AED 4,500 / month): A lockable, furnished private coworking space Al Reem Island teams make their own.
- Meeting room (Hourly booking): Client meetings and calls — members get monthly meeting room credits.
- Day pass (AED 100 / day): Cheap desk space in ADGM for a day — no lease, no commitment.
- Virtual office (From AED 292 / month): A registered ADGM business address with mail handling.

## Frequently asked questions

### How much does a coworking space on Al Reem Island cost?

At Aegis Coworking in Addax Tower, a hot desk is AED 1,000 per month, a dedicated desk AED 1,150 per month (plus a one-time AED 1,200 due-diligence fee), a day pass AED 100 and private offices start from AED 4,500 per month. ADGM government fees are separate.

### Is the coworking space on Al Reem Island inside ADGM?

Yes. Addax Tower on Al Reem Island is within the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM) jurisdiction, so Aegis is a coworking space inside ADGM, not just near it.

Read more:

### What is the difference between a hot desk and a dedicated desk?

A hot desk (flexi desk) lets you use any open seat on the shared coworking floor. A dedicated desk is your own permanent desk with 24/7 access, a locker, extra meeting room credits and an office address suitable for an ADGM licence.

Read more:

### Can I use the coworking space for my ADGM licence?

Yes, with a dedicated desk or a private office — both include an office address suitable for an ADGM licence. A virtual office also provides a registered ADGM business address. The hot desk is for working only.

### What is the cheapest desk space in ADGM?

A day pass at AED 100 is the cheapest way in. For monthly use, the hot desk is AED 1,000 and the dedicated desk at AED 1,150 is the lowest-cost desk that includes an ADGM licence address.

Read more:

### Do members get 24/7 access?

Dedicated desk and private office members have 24/7 access. Tours run Monday to Friday, 9 AM–6 PM.

### Is there a deposit or setup fee?

No deposit, no admin fees and no setup fees, with free registration. The dedicated desk has a one-time AED 1,200 due-diligence fee.

### Can I book a private coworking space for my team?

Yes. Private offices start from AED 4,500 per month for small teams, with medium and large offices priced by layout — all on the same floor as the shared coworking space.

Read more:

### How do I book a tour of the coworking space?

Message us on WhatsApp or call +971 50 392 6316. Tours run Monday to Friday, 9 AM–6 PM, and we can send a video walkthrough if you are abroad.
